title: 第42章 玄晶果，陈玄彬
slug: 乱世武道从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

马车在官道上疾驰。

任忠武在前赶车，陆林则是安置好褚二牛三两人后，就开始修炼。

从白杨镇到绍和县城，至少要三个时辰。

左右无事，也只能拿来修炼。

似乎是有了黑虎锻骨法的刺激。

青松锻骨法淬炼骨骼的效率增加不少。

陆林能感觉到，他的骨骼已经淬炼了九成，只要再努力一段时日，就可以完成一次淬骨。

淬骨是一个循序渐进的过程。

并不是只淬炼骨骼表面就行，还要深入到骨髓深处。

当陆林主动修炼时。

淬骨的效率更高。

快到绍和县时，他就完成了第一次淬骨。

身体骨骼仿佛竹节鞭一般，每一块都在陆林的掌控之中。

砰砰砰。

一连串空爆声响起。

陆林精神一震。

力量又增加了。

武道第一步，锻骨。

其意义并不在于让武者变得多强。

而是夯实根基。

只有更强壮的骨骼，才能承受的起更强大的力量，才能承受的了更可怕的伤害。

真正会增加力量的，是练肉。

将全身上下的肌肉淬炼的如同铁块钢锭一般，武者的力量会得到大幅增加。

由此推理。

三品武者披甲，是淬炼武者的皮肤，增加防御力。

“到了！”

任忠武勒停马车，快步来到生息堂。

这是陈家专门给陈诗华打造的医馆。

陈诗华平时都会住在这里。

即便是过年期间，生息堂也不放假休息。

一大早就有药童，学徒在医馆内忙碌。

接收药材，分门别类，过称称量，核算价格。

药香味浓郁。

“陈郎中，陈郎中。”

任忠武高呼。

立即有药童迎上来。

“这位先生，你受创严重，先来此处清创包扎。”

“我的事不急，快喊陈郎中来，我有两个兄弟，在追捕盗贼时，被人用毒药毒倒，只有陈郎中能救他们。”

“先生稍等。”

药童见任忠武连自己的伤势都不顾，立即明白事情严重性，飞奔着去找陈诗华。

车厢内的陆林，也在几个学徒的帮助下，把褚二牛三抬下来。

看到他们的惨状，几个学徒都禁不住暗暗咂舌。

这明显不是普通的中毒。

一个呼吸困难，一个昏迷失魂，都不是普通病症。

“来了来了！陈郎中来了。”

陆林和任忠武赶忙起身迎了上去。

一位窈窕女子，跟在小药童身后。

她似乎有修行底子，即便是冬日，也只穿一身绿色纱裙，青丝盘起，额头上沁出了些汗珠。

她手里拿着一个古铜色的小药箱，顾不得跟任忠武陆林寒暄，直接蹲下身子，查看褚二牛三的病情。

“这个不严重，取些红米膏来，抹在口鼻处。”

陈诗华安排一句，又看起褚二。

陈诗华的眉头皱起，似乎是在思索着什么。

下一秒，她眉头又平复。

刚想开口说话，突然伸手抹在褚二的脖颈。

“好狠的手段，两位，你们这是遇到了用毒的行家了。”

“是是，陈郎中，你看他还有救吗？”

任忠武没想到，看起来严重的牛三，陈诗华随手就能救好，反而是昏迷过去的褚二，成了难题。

Page (1/3)

The carriage galloped along the official road.

Ren Zhongwu drove the car in front, while Lu Lin arranged for Chu, Er, Niu, three, and two others before starting to practice.

It takes at least three hours to get from Baiyang Town to Shaohe County.

If you have nothing to do, you can only use it for practice.

It seems to be stimulated by the Black Tiger Bone Forging Technique.

The Qingsong Bone Forging Method can greatly increase the efficiency of bone tempering.

Lu Lin could feel that his bones had been tempered by 90%. As long as he worked hard for a while, he could complete the bone tempering.

Bone tempering is a gradual process.

It's not just about tempering the surface of the bones, it also has to go deep into the bone marrow.

When Lu Lin took the initiative to practice.

Bone quenching is more efficient.

When he was approaching Shaohe County, he completed his first bone tempering.

The body's bones were like bamboo whips, and every piece was under Lu Lin's control.

Bang bang bang.

A series of air explosions sounded.

Lu Lin was shocked.

The strength increased again.

The first step in martial arts is to forge bones.

Its significance is not to make the warrior stronger.

But to lay a solid foundation.

Only stronger bones can withstand greater strength and more terrible injuries.

What will really increase strength is muscle training.

By tempering the muscles all over the body like iron ingots, the warrior's strength will be greatly increased.

Reason from this.

The armor worn by third-grade warriors is to temper the warrior's skin and increase its defense.

"We're here!"

Ren Zhongwu stopped the carriage and quickly came to Shengxi Hall.

This is a medical clinic specially built by the Chen family for Chen Shihua.

Chen Shihua usually lives here.

Even during the Chinese New Year, Shengxitang does not take any holidays.

There were medicine boys and apprentices busy in the medical hall early in the morning.

Receive medicinal materials, classify them, weigh them, and calculate prices.

The medicinal aroma is strong.

"Mr. Chen, Dr. Chen."

Ren Zhongwu shouted.

A medicine boy came to greet him immediately.

"Sir, you are seriously injured. Come here first to debridement and bandage."

"My matter is not urgent. Call Dr. Chen. I have two brothers who were poisoned while chasing the thieves. Only Dr. Chen can save them."

"Sir, wait a moment."

Seeing that Ren Zhongwu didn't even care about his own injury, the medicine boy immediately understood the seriousness of the matter and ran to find Chen Shihua.

Lu Lin in the carriage also lifted Chu Erniu San down with the help of several apprentices.

Seeing their miserable condition, several apprentices could not help but secretly smack their tongues.

This was obviously no ordinary poisoning.

One has difficulty breathing and the other is unconscious, these are not ordinary illnesses.

"Come on, come on! Doctor Chen is here."

Lu Lin and Ren Zhongwu quickly stood up and greeted him.

A graceful woman followed behind the little Yaotong.

She seems to have a foundation in spiritual practice. Even in winter, she only wears a green gauze skirt, her black hair is coiled up, and there are some beads of sweat on her forehead.

She held a small bronze medicine box in her hand. She didn't care to exchange greetings with Ren Zhongwu and Lu Lin, and squatted down directly to check Chu Erniu San's condition.

"This is not serious. Take some red rice ointment and apply it on your mouth and nose."

Chen Shihua arranged a sentence and looked at Chu Er again.

Chen Shihua's brows furrowed, as if he was thinking about something.

The next second, her brows calmed down again.

Just as he was about to speak, he suddenly reached out and wiped Chu Er's neck.

"What a cruel method, you two, you have met an expert in using poison."

"Yes, Mr. Chen, do you think he can be saved?"

Ren Zhongwu did not expect that Chen Shihua could easily save Niu San, who looked serious, but Chu Er, who was unconscious, became a problem.
